lines.text: بعضی از این طائفه و آمدن خبرهای اراجیف سیما از طرف مشرق و قتل دزدان و بدکاران
lines.en: some of this group, and the coming of false news, especially from the east, and the killing of thieves and evildoers,

lines.text: و اهل فساد و ضعف حال سپاهیان و غارت جایها و هلاك خوارج و ارزانی اشجار
lines.en: and the people of corruption, and the weakness of the condition of the soldiers, and the plundering of places, and the destruction of the Kharijites, and the cheapness of trees,

lines.text: و ضرر اشترکاران و حرب و قتل و تشویش امرا و لشکریان و ناله خلایق از ظلم و ستم و موت
lines.en: and harm to camel drivers, and war and killing, and the anxiety of emirs and soldiers, and the groaning of the creatures from oppression and tyranny, and the death

lines.text: بزرگی و زدن درم و دنانیر مغشوشه و قلبی ضرابان و صناعان و حکیم کوشیا در حلی گوید
lines.en: of a great one, and the striking of adulterated dirhams and dinars, and the counterfeiting of minters and artisans. And the sage Kushyar says in Hilli:

lines.text: که چون درین حال مریخ در برج ناری بود دلالت کند بر شدت گرما در وقت (و اگر تربیع
lines.en: that when in this state Mars is in a fiery sign, it indicates the intensity of heat at the time (and if it is a quartile

lines.text: باشد) دلالت کند بر موت امیری معروف و کثرت مرض و اسقاط اسب و استر و انقضا
lines.en: it is), it indicates the death of a known emir, and the abundance of disease, and the miscarriage of horses and mules, and the end

lines.text: حرب و خلاف میان ملوك و سلاطین و غم و هم ایشان و خصومت امرا با اکابر و آفت
lines.en: of war, and disagreement among kings and sultans, and their sorrow and grief, and the enmity of emirs with the grandees, and calamity

lines.text: قصابان و صیادان و تباهی نخجیران و درندگان و حیرت مفسدان و بسیاری غم و رنج و فسد
lines.en: to butchers and hunters, and the ruin of prey and predators, and the bewilderment of the corrupt, and much sorrow and suffering and corruption,

lines.text: و بیداد و ستم و سوختن عمارات و محصولات و نقصان اموال بزرگان و طمع حکام از توانگران
lines.en: and injustice and tyranny, and the burning of buildings and crops, and the decrease of the wealth of the great, and the greed of rulers from the rich.

lines.text: (تربیع و مقابله زهره و مریخ) دلالت کند بر رسوا شدن فسقه و فجره و تهمت بر مردان
lines.en: (The quartile and opposition of Venus and Mars) indicates the disgrace of the wicked and the immoral, and accusation against men

lines.text: و کودکان و بدنامی زنان و طلاق و فراق ازواج و اسقاط اجنه و بیماری و فروماندگی
lines.en: and children, and the ill repute of women, and divorce and separation of spouses, and the miscarriage of fetuses, and disease and helplessness

lines.text: خواتین و ارباب طرب و تغییر نرخها و قوة ظالمان و آفت و نقصان اشجار و اثمار
lines.en: of ladies and masters of joy, and the change of prices, and the strength of oppressors, and calamity and decrease of trees and fruits,

lines.text: و تغییر هوا و جستن بادهای مضطرب و قبض خاطرها و موت در خلایق و کساد بازار
lines.en: and the change of weather, and the blowing of turbulent winds, and the contraction of hearts, and death among the creatures, and the stagnation of the market

lines.text: اقمشه و ابریشمینه و فتنه در اقلیم پنجم و ولایت کرمان (اگر مقابله باشد) دلالت کند
lines.en: of fabrics and silks, and sedition in the fifth clime and the province of Kerman. (If it is an opposition) it indicates

lines.text: بر فضیحت زنان نابکار و حیرت و خسارت خواتین و سلیطگی و شوخی زنان و کسا
lines.en: the disgrace of wicked women, and the bewilderment and loss of ladies, and the shrewishness and insolence of women, and the stagnation

lines.text: بازارها و زرق و حیله میان ازواج و بیماری زنان و اندوه اهل طرب و وقوع
lines.en: of markets, and deceit and trickery among spouses, and the illness of women, and the sorrow of the people of joy, and the occurrence

lines.text: نکاحهای بی رغبت و خواری لباس و اقمشه و بادهای مضر و جستن رعد و برق و ظلمت
lines.en: of marriages without desire, and the baseness of clothes and fabrics, and harmful winds, and the striking of thunder and lightning, and darkness

lines.text: هوا و افراط بارندگی در وقت و موت زنی معروف و فرو رفتن یکی از حکام و سلاطین
lines.en: of the air, and excess of rain at the time, and the death of a known woman, and the sinking of one of the rulers and sultans,

lines.text: و فرح امرا و عداوت زنان با شوهران و وقوع مصایب در میان عورات و ارزانی
lines.en: and the joy of emirs, and the enmity of women with husbands, and the occurrence of calamities among women, and the cheapness

lines.text: اسباب و آلات و ادوات زنان و عطریات و مخالفت مطربان و مغنیان و مکروهی در
lines.en: of the goods and instruments and tools of women and perfumes, and the opposition of musicians and singers, and a hateful thing among

lines.text: میان عامه مردم بسبب خیانت و فجور و تعزیر اهل فسق و عصیان (اگر تربیع باشد)
lines.en: the common people because of treason and immorality, and the punishment of the people of corruption and rebellion. (If it is a quartile)

lines.text: دلالت کند بر کثرت خصومت و گفتگوی مردم و ظهور خیانتها و رنج عامه خلایق از ظلم
lines.en: it indicates the abundance of enmity and talk of the people, and the appearance of treasons, and the suffering of the common creatures from oppression,

lines.text: و افتادن مفارقت میان ازواج و پدید آمدن فرقتها و تلبیسها و کثرت زنا و فسق
lines.en: and the falling of separation among spouses, and the appearance of sects and deceptions, and the abundance of adultery and corruption.

summary.headline: Venus and Mars Configurations
summary.text: Astrological judgments on quartile and opposition configurations involving Mars and Venus, including effects on heat, war, rulers, disease, weather, markets, marriage, women, and social disorder. Kushyar’s authority in Hilli is cited, with specific omens for the fifth clime and Kerman.
